brief:
In mcp/forge_mcp/util.py, near line 2151, the 'no actions yet' hint tells the caller how to fill an empty action library:

    "  no actions yet — rigforge_action(action='new', name='idle-loop', "
    "loop=true), then sketch the motion with rigforge_keyframe or import "
    "a clip with rigforge_retarget."

Since that hint was written, three authoring commands landed that are now the most common way an action gets filled: rigforge_walk (a walk cycle), rigforge_punch and rigforge_jump. Update ONLY this hint string so it also offers authoring a clip with rigforge_walk (mentioning punch/jump alongside it is welcome but optional), while keeping rigforge_keyframe and rigforge_retarget as options. Keep the file's voice: one flowing sentence, an em dash after 'no actions yet', concrete tool names. Do not change anything else in the file.
